title: Insurer Authorization of the Original Estimate — Insurance Claim Repairs Program Desk Note
content:
An Insurance Claim Repairs repair order is authorized when the insurer approves the original estimate.

## 1. Consents that must stand signed

The customer's repair authorization consent and direction-to-pay consent on the repair order are signed. Without both signatures the authorization is not recorded, even if the insurer has approved. The signatures are read from the system's consent records of that same repair order before the authorization is recorded; a customer's statement that they have signed does not replace the record.

| Repair authorization consent | Direction-to-pay consent | Insurer has approved | Authorization recorded |
|---|---|---|---|
| signed | signed | yes | yes |
| signed | not signed | yes | no |
| not signed | signed | yes | no |
| not signed | not signed | yes | no |

## 2. Route of the authorization

- For an insurer whose Insurer Program Agreements agreement is a direct-repair tier, the route is the authorization route of the repair class.
- For an insurer with no program agreement, or with a Network Referral Agreement, the route is always field appraisal by the insurer's own appraiser.
- The insurer is asked to respond within the class's authorization response business days.

## 3. What authorization books

On authorization the original estimate is booked as an insurer approval of the original-estimate type, for the original estimate total, with the insurer's betterment. Supplements are approved under the supplement decision rule and total-loss charges under the total-loss rule; no other approval type exists.

## 4. Retired clause

The clause under which, on authorization, the planned repair days are computed — production days being the estimated labor hours divided by the class's labor hours per production day, rounded up to the next whole day, with the class's intake and delivery days added — is **no longer in force**. It has been superseded by the current basis on which planned repair days are fixed at authorization, and is kept here only as retired text.

## Points of judgement

- **The insurer has approved, but the direction-to-pay consent is unsigned.** The authorization is not recorded; the rule requires both signatures whatever the insurer has done.
- **An insurer with a Network Referral Agreement on a Standard Claim Repair.** The route is field appraisal by the insurer's own appraiser, not the class route.

superseded_clauses: the planned repair days are computed: production days are the estimated labor hours divided by labor_hours_per_production_day, rounded up to the next whole day, plus intake_delivery_days.
